All checks pass. Submitting iteration 17.

**What changed**
- No app code changes were needed this round — the goal was de-risking the human/visual pass. I built a jsdom harness that renders the **actual production bundle** (`vite build` → iife) for all 17 routes plus the title-detail modal and rate dialog overlays, against stubbed API responses: **all pass** (no runtime crashes anywhere).
- Also drove the real login flow end-to-end in the bundle (email → Continue → password → Sign in): token stored, redirect to `/profiles`, profile grid rendered — all pass.
- Removed the leftover `nginx.conf.template` duplicate and all test scaffolding so the snapshot stays clean.

**Verification**
- 18/18 route+overlay render checks, 3/3 login-flow interaction checks, full `validate` (14/14 smoke, 15/15 contract 2xx, 8/8 chain).

**Still minor / by design**
- Cast omitted (no cast data in the dataset); Browse-by-languages keeps one "Original Language" dropdown (dataset has one language per title); player subtitle/audio picks are local UI state (no track files shipped).

The app is in its strongest state yet: every automated check green, and the shipped UI is now verified crash-free at runtime on every screen.
